mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as a continuous predictor has a negative relationship with S&P 500 returns; thus, the current low level (0.16%) predicts positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and S&P 500 20-day returns is not negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an easing monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 97.5) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 97.5 and UNRATE < 7.5 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (defined by UNRATE > 7.5% and INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5 and INDPRO < 100 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 850 thousand units signal a recovering housing market, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 850 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 97.5 (2017=100) indicates a strengthening supply chain and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 97.5 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars indicates robust housing sector growth, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST > 850) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 400,000) signals a sustained housing recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 400000 (as measured by 3-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).
